question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Check if there are ties at the 3rd position
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_season AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
best_drivers AS (
    SELECT tdr.year, tdr.constructor_id, tdr.driver_id
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    WHERE TRY_CAST(CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT bd.year, bd.constructor_id, bd.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM best_drivers bd
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON bd.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id AND lr.year = bd.year
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.year, cs.constructor_points, ds.driver_points,
           cs.constructor_points + ds.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_season cs
    JOIN driver_season ds ON cs.constructor_id = ds.constructor_id AND cs.year = ds.year
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 5
